content:
alex_marketing: FYI — TechDaily published a story that incorrectly frames our benchmark. They quoted "3x faster/cost savings across the board" which is inaccurate. Need: legal correction note, a short clarifying line for press, and hold social amplification until corrected.

press_ops_bot: Noted. I'll open a correction request with the reporter and send the embargoed press note update. ETA to reporter: 2h. Do not amplify externally until we confirm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lisa_legal: Draft correction language: "Correction: Our benchmark reports up to 3x unit-cost reduction in cache-friendly, representative web-text workloads; results vary by model size, workload mix, and cache hit-rate. See methodology: <link>." Legal suggests we keep it short and link to methodology.

emma_analytics: Confirming numbers: the "up to 3x" figure is correct for the specific cache-heavy cohort in our tests; we should avoid the word "guaranteed" or blanket statements. Recommend the clarifying parenthetical exactly as Legal proposed.

jess_editor: Press line for immediate use (short): "Clarification: Our benchmark shows up to 3x unit-cost reduction in cache-friendly test cases; outcomes vary by workload. Full methodology: <link>."

mira_ceo: Agree with wording. Also add: "We stand by our methodology and welcome independent validation." as a follow-up line if the reporter asks for commentary.

sam_seo: Social pause: I'll hold scheduled tweets until we get confirmation from the reporter. If the article is updated, we'll push corrected copy. Draft social fallback copy ready if needed.

ops_oncall: No production changes required. This is a comms correction only. We'll monitor traffic but no autoscale action unless media drives abnormal load.

press_ops_bot: Correction request sent to reporter at 1891234700. Will update thread with reporter response. Please do not repost original assets until we confirm the corrected text.

alex_marketing: Thanks everyone. Final action: legal to approve exact correction copy, press_ops_bot to confirm reporter updated, social to hold. If we get update within 2h we proceed with corrected post and amplification. Please react with :thumbsup: once you've acted.
